night_initialization.interpretation: The initial environment was set to zero sun, haze, scatter, zenith, clouds, and fog before it entered the rendered tree. The first completed frame was sampled. This checks initialization/update behavior, not a calibrated night sky.

sample_regions.values: mean display-referred RGB from the captured Compatibility viewport image, each channel in [0,1]

settle_definition.caveat: An 8-frame stable sample is an operational capture criterion; it does not measure hidden cubemap state or target-GPU cost.
settle_definition.metric: maximum absolute channel difference from a same-renderer target across sky, matte, and specular RGB means
